messages:
alex: Hey team — customer on prod observed Python streaming client hang when auth token rotates mid-response. They see the generator stop yielding after a partial token (looks like a half UTF-8 char) and the HTTP connection stays open. Example log:

alex: ```
INFO 2026-05-03T14:12:23Z client.py:stream_start request_id=abc123
DEBUG 2026-05-03T14:12:27Z sse.py:got_event data="event: message"
data: {\"delta\":\"The quick brown f\"}\n\n"
DEBUG 2026-05-03T14:12:27Z auth.py:refresh_token rotating creds for customer A
WARN 2026-05-03T14:12:27Z generator.py:yield_partial saw partial utf8, buffering
# then nothing else, generator never returns and client waits
```

maria: Thanks — can you paste the minimal repro script and the SDK wheel version?

alex: Customer is on redwood-python 0.12.4, requests 2.31, running in gunicorn worker (sync). Repro script (simplified):

alex: ```python
from redwood import StreamingClient
client = StreamingClient(api_key=...)
def stream():
    for chunk in client.text_stream("gimme story", stream=True):
        yield chunk

# run inside gunicorn worker, rotate token externally after ~4s
```

ingrid: Quick Qs: is the customer using the SSE fallback transport or native http-chunked? any proxies/load balancers between app and redwood?

alex: They said SSE mode (using EventSource via our py shim). Behind an internal edge LB that copies keepalive headers. No proxy altering body.
josh: I suspect a parsing boundary bug when auth rotation injects a 204/no-content keepalive or the token-swap response includes a short retry header that confuses the SSE parser. Can you capture raw TCP bytes? Even a hex snippet around the time of the partial token helps.

alex: Pasted a minimal dump (trimmed):

alex: ```
...0d0a0d0a: event: message
data: {\"delta\":\"The quick brown f\"}
0d0a: 
# then auth refresh triggers: chunk-length: 0
0d0a0d0a: event: heartbeat
data:
0d0a
# parser treats empty data as heartbeat then stops 
```

ingrid: That dump is useful. Repro plan: (1) run local SSE server that emits a multibyte UTF-8 token split across two chunks, (2) simultaneously simulate auth rotation by injecting a zero-length keepalive chunk between the two halves, (3) run redwood-python 0.12.4 and 0.12.3 to compare.
maria: Can you confirm whether this appears on dedicated/private or hosted? Customer reported in hosted region us-west-2.

alex: Hosted us-west-2. They escalated because app-level timeouts don't trigger (the generator never raises).

josh: Quick workaround: force the client to buffer and decode incremental bytes rather than assuming events are full utf8 sequences per chunk. Short-term: set stream_timeout=30 and run with a background thread that cancels generator if no new complete tokens emitted in Xs. Longer-term: we'll push a small parser fix.

ingrid: Reproduced locally on 0.12.4 — generator hung exactly when an empty SSE ``data:
`` event landed mid-codepoint. 0.12.3 doesn't hang (it treats empty data as a noop and continues). Looks like a change in incremental decode behavior introduced in 0.12.4.

maria: Can we get a patch? If it's small, we should hotfix hosted and provide guidance for customers to pin or upgrade. Also need incident ticket for billing/user impact.

support-bot: Created INC-2026-5126 (priority: high) — assigned to eng-streaming.

ingrid: Patch idea: when buffering bytes across chunks, ensure we attempt to decode with 'surrogatepass' or use incremental UTF8 decoder from codecs.incrementaldecoder to avoid raising on incomplete sequences; also treat empty data events as no-ops rather than end-of-stream. I'll sketch a PR.

josh: Also add a unit test: split the multibyte token across chunk boundary with an empty SSE event inserted. CI should catch this.

alex: Customer update queued: will recommend temporary pin to 0.12.3 or apply client-side timeout; offering support window to reproduce with eng.

maria: Thanks. @ingrid @josh please post PR number and deployment ETA when available. :thumbsup:

ingrid: PR draft here (internal): https://git.redwood.ai/eng/streaming/compare/partial-sse-fix (WIP) — tests added. ETA for hotfix deploy (hosted): 24-48h if tests pass.

josh: Note for docs: mention that running in sync Gunicorn + token rotation may surface this and recommend worker config or using async workers until full fix rolled.

alex: Customer acked, asked if we can escalate billing hold while we verify no duplicate tokens were billed. Raising with billing separately.

maria: Filed billing ticket BILL-789 to review token accounting for partial streamed requests.

support-bot: Added incident tag: streaming-parser-hang, notified oncall eng-ml.

alex: Closing loop — will post follow-up when hotfix deployed and customer validation done.
